'''Guanta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Guanta was a seasoned and skilled combatant and an [[Wookiee Chieftain|elder]] in his community. At the end of the Clone Wars, Guanta answered a call for [[Merumeru's volunteer soldiers|warriors]] put out by the Wookiee [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Merumeru/Legends|Merumeru]]. As [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] stormed the [[Beach/Legends|beach]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], Guanta stood behind Merumeru and alongside other warriors as they defended the city during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|battle]] of Kachirho.

==Biography==
[[File:Wookiee_trench.png|thumb|left|300px|As Merumeru gave the call to attack, Guanta joined the mass of Wookiees to resist the Separatist invasion.]]
Guanta was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="CSWE I 373" /> from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] who had become an [[Wookiee Chieftain|elder]] in his culture<ref name="SWC:TP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] raged throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="NEC 84">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a force of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|attacked]] Guanta's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. A rival force of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], under the leadership of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], arrived on Kashyyyk to help the Wookiees resist the invasion.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> As the Separatist forces neared the [[Beach/Legends|beachfront]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], the Wookiee [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Merumeru/Legends|Merumeru]] issued a clarion call for [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to defend the settlement. Guanta was among the [[Merumeru's volunteer soldiers|many volunteers]] who answered the summons.<ref name="CVD 177" />

As the assemblage waited behind a set of revetments for the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] to draw near and for Merumeru to issue the call to attack,<ref name="SWC:TP" /> Guanta was in the front row immediately behind the leader.<ref name="TWAB">{{SW|url=video/the-wookiees-are-back|series=Making Episode III Webdocs|text=The Wookiees Are Back!}}</ref> As the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] approached, the Wookiee leader stood atop the barricades and roared for his comrades to charge into battle;<ref name="SWC:TP" /> Guanta and the others then rushed to meet their opponents in combat.<ref name="CSWE I 373" /> The combined force of Wookiees and [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] bested the Separatist war machine and won the battle of Kachirho. Nevertheless, the Galactic Republic gave way to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] soon thereafter. In the aftermath, the Wookiees of Kashyyyk were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] into Imperial work camps.<ref name="CVD 177" />

==Personality and traits==
By the end of the Clone Wars, Guanta was a seasoned warrior, skilled in battle.<ref name="CSWE II 309">{{CSWECite|II|309|Merumeru}}</ref> The suffix ''-anta'' in his name meant "[[Judge/Legends|judge]]" and "leader" in his native language, [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]].<ref name="Callsigns: Names of Kashyyyk">{{GamerCite|10|Callsigns: Names of Kashyyyk}}</ref> When his fellow Wookiee Merumeru sounded the call for volunteer soldiers, Guanta became a loyal member of the captain's volunteer [[Army/Legends|army]].<ref name="SWC:TP" /> At the [[Time/Legends|time]] he fought in the Battle of Kachirho, Guanta had a stocky, well-muscled build that afforded him the ability to pull [[Limb/Legends|arms]] out of their sockets. His [[Color/Legends|brown]] fur was streaked with blond, especially in the area around his face and head. The Wookiee bound his chin and neck fur into six ponytails with black bands. His skin was dark brown in color. An aged specimen of his [[Species/Legends|species]], Guanta's [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] had yellowed by the time of the Clone Wars. He was missing his top right incisor, and he had a gap between his two bottom front teeth.<ref name="CVD 177" /> Guanta was right-handed.<ref name="OWSW 967">''[[Obsessed With Star Wars]]'', question 967</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Chewie's actually way younger than all of you. You guys are the senior warriors of the pack here, and Chewie is just a little kid in this movie, and he grows up to be an important Wookiee later on.|Rob Coleman, to the Wookiee extras during the filming of ''Revenge of the Sith''|<ref name="TWAB" />}}
[[File:Chillin_wookiees.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Guanta (third from left) was one of several Wookiee characters created for ''Revenge of the Sith''.]]
Guanta, originally referred to as either Wookiee #1, 2, or 6,<ref name="actor">No source explicitly names the actor who played Guanta or the number by which the Wookiee was known during filming. However, based on the list of actors and numbers in ''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]'' and removing from that list the Wookiees for whom explicit number and actor identifications have been made in that source, in the [[Making Episode III Webdocs]] episode "The Wookiees Are Back!," and in {{DB|character|merumeru|Merumeru}} and {{DB|character|salporin|Salporin}}, the possible number and actor designations for Guanta can be narrowed down.</ref> was one of six Wookiees created by the [[Industrial Light & Magic]] creature department under the supervision of [[Rebecca Hunt]] for [[2005]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. Constructing the costumes for Guanta and the other Wookiees was the largest and most difficult task for the department during the film's pre-production. The suit had two main parts: a lower body suit to provide the character's musculature and an outer suit of modacrylic hair. A mask, hands, and feet completed the ensemble.<ref name="TWAB" /><ref name="SWC:TP" /> The muscle layer and mask were based on a body cast of an actor<ref name="TWAB" />&mdash;either [[Steven Foy]], [[Julian Khazzouh]], or [[James Rowland]]<ref name="actor" />&mdash;and thus tailored specifically to his physique. The Creature Shop team added the Wookiee's hair by hand under the guidance of Fabrication Supervisor [[Lou Elsey]].<ref name="TWAB" />

The labor-intensive process needed to create the suits for Guanta and the other Wookiees pushed the filming of the Battle of Kashyyyk scenes into the summer of [[2004]], making them some of the final live-action sequences shot for the movie. The scenes were directed by Animation Supervisor [[Rob Coleman]] and marked his live-action directorial debut.<ref name="SWC:TP" /> On [[May 17]], against a greenscreen at [[Fox Studios, Sydney|Fox Studios]] in [[Wikipedia:Sydney|Sydney]], [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australia]],<ref name="MOROTS 184">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Coleman had the costumed Australian actors repeatedly rush over a green barrier that would later be replaced by a computer-generated barricade. Each take, the actors switched weapons and accessories but kept the same Wookiee suits. Coleman and his team later composited the shots to create the scene in ''Revenge of the Sith'' where the Wookiee volunteer army charges at Merumeru's command. However, Guanta and the other Wookiee characters were filmed numerous times to fill the front row of Wookiees in the shot, and no source has identified exactly which of the assembled Wookiees is Guanta and which are merely Wookiees that look like him.<ref name="TWAB" /> Guanta is named as having been one of the Wookiees in the crowd with Merumeru,<ref name="SWC:TP" /> so this article counts any ''[[Star Wars]]'' publication that features an image of the Wookiee army behind the barricade as an appearance of Guanta. Similarly, [[Hasbro]] released a Wookiee action figure called "Wookiee Heavy [[Gunner/Legends|Gunner]]" in 2005 as part of its [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (toy line)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' toy line]]. The portrait used for the card depicts Guanta;<ref name="ROTS:WHG">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (toy line)|pack=#68: Wookiee Heavy Gunner (Blast Attack!)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/ROTS0568wookiee.asp}}</ref> however, the toy itself is a repaint of a previous action figure based on the costume of [[Grakchawwaa/Legends|Grakchawwaa]], another Wookiee from the film.<ref name="ROTS:WW">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (toy line)|pack=Sneak Preview #3: Wookiee Warrior|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/ROTSsneakwookiee.asp}}</ref>

Guanta was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was released a month prior to the film.<ref name="Visual">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The novel ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'', first published in 2005 by [[Del Rey]], features a Wookiee character named [[Guania]] who participates in the cleanup effort following the Battle of Kashyyyk. Because several other Wookiees who appear in the book are characters from ''Revenge of the Sith'', such as [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Lachichuk/Legends|Lachichuk]], and [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]],<ref name="DL 38">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> ''Star Wars'' writer [[Bob Vitas]] has suggested that Guania's name is an error, and that Luceno intended the character to be Guanta.<ref name="CUSWE">{{WebCite|url=http://cuswe.org/entryclass.asp?page=16&search=G|text=The Completely Unofficial Star Wars Encyclopedia - Version 12.0|author=Bob Vitas|date=2007-05-21|work=The Completely Unofficial Star Wars Encyclopedia|quote=Could this be typo, and really represent the Wookiee Guanta?|archivedate=20111204203023}}</ref> However, the [[2008]] reference work ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' includes entries for both Guanta and Guania, establishing the two as distinct individuals.<ref name="CSWE I 373" /><ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I|373|Guania}}</ref>
